title: Best colours for fair skin: a guide for women in India
description: Raspberry, deep teal, plum and coral for fair skin, with undertone tests, three outfits and brands you can buy in India.
intro: Fair skin shows colour clearly. Colours that are too pale can fade into you. Colours with a little depth give your face shape. Your undertone refines the choice. This guide shows you how to find it at home, and what to buy and retire.

sections.heading: Find your undertone at home in five minutes
sections.body: Undertone is the quiet colour under your skin. It is not the same as how light or dark you are. Fair skin is light, and it still comes in warm, cool and neutral undertones. You may see pink, peach, golden or olive. Do the three tests below in daylight, near a window, with no filter and no coloured light. Then trust the answer that shows up twice.
tips: Vein test. Look at the inside of your wrist. Mostly green veins point to a warm undertone. Mostly blue or purple veins point to a cool one. A mix of both usually means neutral. On deeper skin the veins are harder to see, so skip this test if you cannot tell and lean on the other two.

White versus cream test. Hold a plain white shirt under your chin, then a cream or ivory one. If cream makes your face look healthier and stark white looks harsh, you lean warm. If crisp white looks clean and cream looks a little yellow or flat, you lean cool. If both look fine, you are likely neutral.

Jewellery test. Try a gold chain and a silver chain against your neck. If gold makes your skin glow, you lean warm. If silver does the same, you lean cool. If both work, you are neutral, and you get to wear both.

sections.heading: What fair skin usually pairs with
sections.body: Fair skin spans warm and cool. A warm-leaning woman with a peach or golden base looks great in coral, warm teal and olive. A cool-leaning woman with a rosy base looks great in raspberry, plum and periwinkle. What most fair skin shares is lower natural contrast, so colours with some depth help your features show up. Very pale outfits can blend into your face, so pair them with a stronger colour near it.
tips: Warm-leaning: coral, peach-orange, warm teal, olive, cream. Gold jewellery suits these.
Cool-leaning: raspberry, plum, periwinkle, deep teal, crisp white. Silver jewellery suits these.
Neutral: deep teal, rose and pine green suit both sides.

sections.heading: Colours to buy, and the ones to retire
sections.body: Buy colours with medium to deep intensity and use pale shades as a base layer. A raspberry kurta or a deep teal dupatta frames the face and adds definition. Retire very pale shades as the main colour near your face, since they match your skin lightness.
tips: Buy: raspberry, deep teal, plum, periwinkle, coral and pine green.
Upgrade: pale pink and pale beige work better when paired with a deeper dupatta or bolder earrings.
Retire: near-white beige, very pale pink and washed lavender as your main colour.
Quick check: hold the colour at your chin in daylight. If your eyes and lips look clearer, it works.

pieces: White straight trousers (Marks & Spencer or AND)
looks.why: Coral lifts warm and peachy fair skin, and white keeps it fresh.

tips: Put your strongest colour near your face and keep the rest quiet.
Gold for warm, silver for cool, either if both look right.

faq.q: Is fair skin warm or cool?
faq.a: Either, or neutral. Fair describes depth. Undertone is separate. Run the three tests in this guide.
Soft ones with some colour do, such as periwinkle and sage. Very pale shades can fade near the face.

faq.q: What lipstick goes with these outfits?
faq.a: Warm-leaning: coral and peach. Cool-leaning: raspberry, rose and plum. Neutral: either.
Yes. Black gives strong contrast on fair skin. If it feels harsh at the neckline, use deep navy or charcoal.
